notes:
High-level summary:
- Product: developer IDE copilot (VS Code / JetBrains), in-IDE code completion and refactor suggestions, context-aware code search.
- Core ask: dual-mode deployment: low-latency hosted API for interactive copilot + reserved/dedicated capacity for heavy nightly embedding/indexing jobs.
- Streaming: target 99p tail latency <= 80ms for token-by-token streaming inside IDE. Prefers sub-50ms median. "We can't afford >200ms tail — devs notice instantly."
- Model/version pinning: must be able to pin model variant for the copilot and rollback to a previous model on regression. Also want automated rollback on quality regressions during rollout.
- Background jobs: weekly full-embedding refresh across ~5M code files (monorepo + OSS mirrors). Incremental deltas should be processed within 15 minutes of push; nightly bulk reindexing windows acceptable for full refresh.
- Throughput needs: embedding pipeline capable of sustained 120k embeds/hour during batch windows; indexing pipeline needs batching, dedup, sharding and resume support. Cost-sensitivity: prefers batching + quantized models for background jobs to reduce unit cost.
- Routing/fallback: interactive copilot should route to lower-cost variants outside business hours and fallback to smaller models if latency spikes. Need transparent per-token cost and latency analytics.
- Security/compliance: SSO/SAML for SSO, KMS integration for key management, audit logging and exportable traces for compliance. Data residency: code for EU customers must remain in EU regions.
- POC plan: 6-week POC covering (1) 50-seat copilot with streaming perf target, (2) embedding refresh POC on 100k files, (3) cost-per-embed measurement and a recommended batching/quantization profile from Redwood Optimize.
- Quote from CTO: "If embeddings can't be regenerated within our nightly window we have stale search results — unacceptable."
- Pricing sensitivity: wants a clear comparison (hosted incremental + dedicated nightly commit) vs fully private deployment.
- Notes/shorthand: POC metrics = latency_99p, median_stream_time, embeds_per_hour, cost_per_embed; ask Redwood for suggested batch sizes, KV cache reuse, and model quantization profiles.
